privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.what: Names, email addresses and phone numbers of the people your church invites, and the liturgies you prepare together.
privacy.ip: IP addresses are kept only briefly, to block people guessing passwords, and are deleted within an hour.
privacy.why: To let your church team prepare and publish liturgies together.
privacy.who: Members who are allowed to see the member list can see contact details. The server's administrator can see everything stored on the server.
privacy.phones: Members who can approve liturgies can see the phone numbers of the people assigned to a liturgy, to send them the service details by WhatsApp. Other members never see them.
privacy.offline: To let you read when there is no network, this app saves the last published liturgies and your assignments (up to five liturgies) on your phone. They are deleted when you log out. On a shared phone, log out when you are done.

import.title: Import songs
import.intro: Choose how to hand over your songs. Nothing is saved to the library yet: you will look at every song first and choose what happens to it.

import.paste_too_long: These lyrics are too long (at most 200,000 characters).
import.ol_intro: Files exported from OpenLP or another program that writes OpenLyrics (.xml). You can choose several files at once.
import.cp_intro: Chord sheets in the ChordPro format (.cho, .chordpro, .pro or .txt). The chords are left out; only the lyrics are kept. A file with several songs gives several songs.
import.files_hint: Plain text in UTF-8, at most 1 MiB each and 5 MiB together.
